author: Disney Parks YouTube
text:
Learn character drawing at “Olaf Draws!” where Olaf is your cheerful companion ❄️ #DisneyWorld
The Magic of Disney Animation opens September 14 at Disney’s Hollywood Studios ✨

At “Olaf Draws!” you’ll go step-by-step through the creative process, guided by Disney Animation artists through recorded tips, techniques, and stories from inside the studio. Brought to life as an all-new Audio-Animatronics figure, Olaf’s playful humor brings a fun, laugh-filled experience that leaves you feeling inspired.

You don’t have to cross your fingers or wish upon a star to get the song “September” – on that day to remember, Earth, Wind and Fire’s iconic anthem will play all day long!
